facts: Parties: Eskdale Engineering Ltd (Buyer), Whitlock Marine Ltd (Seller); the Company is Foxley Software Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 11 April 2026; Closing is scheduled for 10 July 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,075,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $3,000,000.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 12 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 12 months after termination of employment.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $4,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $2,200,000.
